bounded_interpretation.causal_confirmation: A separate replay stops at the next transition-initiator entry after the fatal boundary and runs that invocation to its return; health changes from nonfatal to negative while lives and scene stay fixed.
bounded_interpretation.forbidden_claim: Do not infer from the filename/context that Hopper or any actor caused the damage, complete D20/F15, or generalize to other boss, scripted, bonus, special or exceptional deaths.

bounded_open_frontier.death_classes: Other bosses, scripted, bonus, special and exceptional deaths remain open.
